Dear Senator @SenSanders 

I cannot thank you enough for bringing up this issue. As a mother bound to the bedside of my 15-year-old daughter, who has been severely bedridden since contracting COVID-19 at school in December 2022, I am writing from a place of profound personal struggle and professional insight.

Firstly, it's vital for the Senate to recognize the existence of families like mine, trapped within the confines of our homes, unable to voice our challenges in forums where our absence is often misinterpreted as indifference. The perspectives shared at the hearing, while valuable, did not fully encompass the spectrum of hardships faced by families like ours.

As both a physician and a mother, I have witnessed firsthand the limitations of our current medical understanding of Long COVID. My husband and I have exhausted every possible healthcare avenue globally, only to realize that the problem transcends the reach of current medical interventions. Here are the critical points I believe warrant immediate attention:

Long COVID is a medical enigma that demands more than the cursory attention it currently receives. Allocating substantial funding for research is imperative to unravel its mysteries, rather than inadvertently casting blame on physicians who are grappling with the unknown.

The medical community urgently needs a CME-accredited, mandatory course on Long COVID. This will aid in proper diagnosis and help mitigate the ongoing dismissal and gaslighting of patients' symptoms.

Educational accommodations for children suffering from Long COVID are non-negotiable. The vast severity range of this condition requires tailored educational programs.

On a personal note, my own career as a neurologist and dementia expert, recognized across Europe for my social initiatives, has been put on hold. The noble Alzheimer's School project that I have been nurturing is now a distant dream as I navigate the complexities of Long COVID's impact on my family.

Your attention to these matters can truly make a difference in the lives of many families silently battling Long COVID.
